title: Confusing Controls and Features
summary: Reviewers describe the G60's controls and features as confusing to learn and use, especially when trying to find functions or stop unwanted behavior.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on too many confusing buttons and features, difficulty figuring out functions at first, and trouble making the car do or stop doing something.

limitations: The sample is small, so examples are limited to a few comments about confusing controls and feature use.
The topic is narrowly evidenced by short fragments, so specific affected systems or buttons are not always identifiable.
